_note: role=intro is a designed slide, role=footage is spoken over the capture, role=outro closes. The number of footage lines IS the number of beats the recorder must mark. `say` is spoken, `cap` is the on-screen subtitle -- keep them separate: a glyph like the command key reads badly aloud, and a subtitle should be shorter than a sentence.

lines.title: Command Bar
lines.sub: Cmd+K becomes a launcher - you type a command, not a query
lines.say: This is Command Bar. It takes over Command K and turns it into a launcher: you type a command, not a query.
lines.cap: Command Bar: Cmd+K becomes a launcher

lines.title: Every Keystroke
lines.sub: The old palette scanned an unindexed session corpus on every key
lines.say: It replaces a search box that scanned an unindexed corpus of sessions on every keystroke, on the gateway's event loop, stalling unrelated chats.
lines.cap: The old Cmd+K scanned an unindexed corpus on every key

lines.say: Out of the box the app is off. The slot has no owner, so the host renders what it always did: the old palette.
lines.cap: No owner for the slot - the host renders its own palette

lines.say: One manifest line says it replaces quick-search. The host no longer picks what to render, and the top bar flips to Run a command.
Every row names its kind on the right, so you can tell a command from an app before you press Enter.

lines.title: Command Bar
lines.sub: An app that replaces a component in a pre-wired slot
lines.say: Command Bar. Off by default, a request-free root, reversible at any time.
lines.cap: Command Bar - an app that replaces a host component
